items.claim: Stephanie Luciano has a speed edge over Marina Spasik.
items.quote: I think that she's going to have a bit of a speed edge over Spasic.

items.claim: Marina Spasik has a striking background in kickboxing and Muay Thai and shows good forward pressure.
items.quote: Spasik has a striking background, kickboxing and Muay Thai, and she's pretty decent. I like her forward pressure.

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano holds a true advantage in the grappling department over Spasik.
items.quote: I think Luciano's true advantage is the grappling. I could see Luciano hitting takedowns and putting Spazik in some compromised positions on the ground.

items.claim: Marina Spasik gave up double leg takedowns and struggled with takedown defense against lower-level competition.
items.quote: She was giving up double leg takedowns. Be was taking her down with double legs... I'm concerned with the takedown defense.

items.claim: Alexander Popek is typically a light heavyweight fighting as a heavyweight.
items.quote: Pope, he's a light heavyweight typically.

items.claim: Alexander Popek allows opponents to dictate pace and pressure and runs the risk of getting backed up against heavyweights.
items.quote: I don't like that he allows some of his opponents to dictate the pace and pressure. And then when you're fighting a big giant in Lea, I kind of see him getting backed up

items.claim: Jovon Lea hits hard with good straight rights and possesses a dangerous headkick.
items.quote: Lea hits hard. He's got good straight rights. He's got a dangerous headkick.
